name: Korean peninsula
value: Missile salvo 4 Nov; 4th launch in a month
summary: North Korea fired several missiles on 4 Nov, its fourth launch in a month
state: North Korea fired several missiles toward the Sea of Japan on 4 Nov local time, its fourth weapons launch in a month, South Korea's military said (US News; Washington Post). The launch followed Pyongyang's denial of US claims that it stole about $6.3bn from Binance. No nuclear test or ICBM overflight of Japan has been reported as of 5 Nov.
for_you: No direct effect for most people. Travellers to South Korea and Japan should follow FCDO travel advice and local alerts.
rubric_hit: Ballistic missile launches = Watch; no nuclear test or ICBM overflight

why: North Korea is a nuclear state with ICBMs; tension here involves the US, China, Japan and Russia simultaneously.
drivers: Missile tests, Russia–DPRK military cooperation, US–ROK exercises, border incidents.
